diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a repeating cycle (period 3 MIN) containing three actions. The candidate implemented a one-shot sequence with a trailing delay, causing it to terminate after the first execution. Evidence F2 shows the IR firing the siren at t=190000, while the candidate emitted nothing because it had already terminated. The IR cycle requires rearming and repetition, which the candidate lacks.
